title: UK Data Protection Act 2018 — Statute profile
subject: UK Data Protection Act 2018
summary: UK Data Protection Act 2018 is a statute of United Kingdom enacted in 2018, in the area of data privacy. UK law implementing data protection rules alongside the GDPR, enacted 23 May 2018. It is formally cited as 2018 c. 12.
key_points: Core effect: UK law implementing data protection rules alongside the GDPR, enacted 23 May 2018.
guidance: General information only, not legal advice. Use the citation to look up the current official text; statutes are amended over time.
